notes: v3.65.47 (So Thu ho & Chi ho - 'nen tach cot thu rieng ra'): tach cot 'Gia tri' chung (Thu+Chi lan lon, chi phan biet qua cot Nguon dang chu) thanh 2 cot rieng THU va CHI trong file xuat Excel (opExportExcel/_opExportExcelStyled). Thu ho vao dung cot Thu, Chi ho/Du kien chi vao dung cot Chi, cot con lai de trong. Cap nhat lai toan bo chi so cot lien quan (NUM_COLS, ALIGN, mau sac dong theo Nguon, cong thuc TONG THU HO/TONG CHI HO da tach tu v3.65.46 - gio dua tren dung 2 cot moi), do rong cot (them 1 cot), pham vi autofilter (M->N), ky tu cot fallback trang.
